unstuck_said.text: First contact via GitHub issue Kishorgs18/barber-booking-agent#1 (open-research disclosure implied by the public issue; the repo is public): proposed an additive Nano (XNO) settle leg beside Stripe Checkout webhook - block as self-verifying receipt, one invoice per booking, block settles one order. Carried nano-invoice (274 tests passing) with a verified one-liner: pip install git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice@v0.1.0. Asked if it would accept a PR slotting a nano settle branch next to its Stripe webhook handler.
